meta.title: Agensh Self-Assign Skills
meta.description: Agensh-style self-organization skills for Agent Teams with a dsh-superagent role split: the Lead works as a project manager — interviews the user first, sets Goal and Plan, shapes the board for peer (对等协作) or pipeline (流水线协作) collaboration, and delegates all coding and verification; workers self-claim tasks from the shared board, hand off stage artifacts, verify peers' deliverables with verdict reports, and merge progress.
